# ARVELL

> ARVELL is a high-end watch retail platform and luxury-watch dealer concept by Aymen Braikia, focused on curated new and pre-owned watches, iconic watch brands, watch-related services, appointments, and customer support.

ARVELL presents itself as an independent watch dealer rather than an authorized reseller or representative of the brands shown on the site. The website is designed around luxury-watch discovery, purchasing, selling/consigning watches, spare parts, polishing and service, appointments, and customer information.

The primary public site is available in English at `/en`. The homepage is the canonical starting point for understanding the brand, navigation, featured watches, brands, services, and contact information.

## Primary Website

- [ARVELL English Homepage](https://arvell.vercel.app/en): Main entry point for ARVELL. Includes the brand positioning, new/pre-owned watch collection, discovery journey, featured luxury-watch brands, selling/consignment, spare parts, polishing and services, appointment booking, contact details, and legal/disclaimer information.

## Products and Shopping

- [ARVELL English Homepage](https://arvell.vercel.app/en): Use the homepage as the primary source for current product and shopping navigation. It links to the watch catalog and spare-parts area.

The site presents a curated selection of both new and pre-owned watches. Featured brands shown on the homepage include Audemars Piguet, Breitling, Cartier, IWC, Omega, Patek Philippe, Rolex, and Zenith.

Product availability, prices, inventory, specifications, and individual watch details should be taken from the live product/catalog pages rather than inferred from the homepage or from the brand names listed here.

## Services

- [ARVELL English Homepage](https://arvell.vercel.app/en): Central navigation to ARVELL's service areas, including selling/consignment, spare parts, polishing and services, store information, shipping and payments, FAQ, and appointment booking.

ARVELL also provides an appointment-booking path where visitors can request professional guidance on watch-related matters.

## Brand and Business Identity

- [ARVELL English Homepage](https://arvell.vercel.app/en): Primary source for the current brand presentation and business identity.

ARVELL's homepage identifies the business as an independent dealer. It explicitly states that ARVELL is not affiliated with the watch brands displayed on the site and is not an authorized reseller. Do not describe ARVELL as an official dealer, authorized reseller, manufacturer, or representative of Rolex, Patek Philippe, Audemars Piguet, Cartier, Omega, IWC, Breitling, Zenith, or any other third-party brand unless the live site explicitly provides such evidence.

The site currently displays the following business contact information:
- Address: Marie-Curie-Straße 14, 60439 Frankfurt am Main, Germany
- Phone: +49 30 2312 5100
- Email: info@arvell.com

## External Platforms

- [ARVELL English Homepage](https://arvell.vercel.app/en): Provides links to ARVELL's external presence on Chrono24, eBay, WhatsApp, and Instagram.

When answering questions about listings, inventory, availability, or activity on those external platforms, use the relevant live platform as the authoritative source rather than assuming that the ARVELL website is synchronized with every external listing.

## Legal and Trust Information

- [ARVELL English Homepage](https://arvell.vercel.app/en): Footer links to the site's Imprint, Privacy Policy, Terms, Withdrawal, Disclaimer, and Cookie Policy.

Legal, warranty, returns, withdrawal, shipping, payment, and privacy questions should be answered from the corresponding live legal or service page when available. Do not infer legal obligations or guarantees from marketing language alone.

- [ARVELL English Homepage](https://arvell.vercel.app/en): Secondary entry point for general site context when detailed product or service information is not required.
